I’m 60, no schooling, but I’ve been on this land for 40 years. Me and my wife, we got 7.5 mu in Quzhou. Five mu I keep for cotton — that’s always been my main crop, what brings the cash. The other 2.5 mu I plant wheat in the fall, then squeeze maize in right after I cut the wheat in June. That wheat and maize is for our own flour and some feed, maybe sell a little.

Now it’s April, time to get the cotton in the ground. I plant around the 20th, when the dirt feels warm enough. I buy seed from the shop in town — not the fancy expensive kind, the regular one that works. Costs about 50 yuan a mu. I till with my old tractor; she’s 20 years old but still runs. For fertilizer, I put it all down at planting, one time. I tell the shop man “same as last year but a bit less,” because cotton price wasn’t good last year and we’re tight on cash. He weighs out the bags for me — I don’t know the exact numbers, but it’s a bag of compound and some urea for each mu. I’ll water the cotton twice, July and August, when the flowers need it. Pumping costs electricity but you can’t skip it. I spray for weeds before planting, then for bollworms maybe three, four times in summer. Me and my wife do it with our backpack sprayer. Picking is just us two mostly, takes over a month. If my nephew has time I’ll ask him for a couple days. I expect about 250 kg per mu if the weather’s normal.

The wheat’s already in the ground from last October. I put base fertilizer down then, and I spread urea in March when it greened up. Now I just need to water it once in April when it starts shooting up, and maybe once in May if it don’t rain. No more fertilizer now — waste of money. I saved most of the seed from last year, so seed cost is small. Should get about 400 kg per mu.

After wheat harvest in early June, I got maybe a week to get maize in before the season slips away. I plant the local yellow kind, matures quick. Seed is cheap, about 25 yuan per mu. One batch of fertilizer at planting, then I mostly leave it alone. Maybe water once in August if it’s dry. One spray for weeds when it’s small. Expect 450 kg per mu, maybe 500 if it’s a good year.

Money is always the problem. Seed about 300 yuan, fertilizer around 700, pesticide mostly for cotton about 500, electricity for water maybe 400. And maybe 200 yuan if I need to hire a hand for a day or two. That’s about 2,100 yuan. I don’t have much more than that, so I can’t do more even if the shop man says I should.
